Czech

[edit]
Czech Wikipedia has an article on:
psychologie
Wikipedia cs

Etymology

[edit]

From psycho- +‎ -logie.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈpsɪxoloɡɪjɛ]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: psy‧cho‧lo‧gie

Noun

[edit]

psychologie f

  1. psychology
    Synonym: (obsolete) dušezpyt

Declension

[edit]
Declension of psychologie (soft feminine)
singular plural
nominative psychologie psychologie
genitive psychologie psychologií
dative psychologii psychologiím
accusative psychologii psychologie
vocative psychologie psychologie
locative psychologii psychologiích
instrumental psychologií psychologiemi

Related terms

[edit]
  • psychický
  • psycholog
  • psychologický
  • psycholožka

Further reading

[edit]
  • “psychologie”, in Příruční slovník jazyka českého (in Czech), 1935–1957
  • “psychologie”, in Slovník spisovného jazyka českého (in Czech), 1960–1971, 1989
  • “psychologie”, in Internetová jazyková příručka (in Czech), 2008–2026

Dutch

[edit]
Dutch Wikipedia has an article on:
psychologie
Wikipedia nl

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French psychologie, from Latin psychologia (coined by Marko Marulić from Ancient Greek ψυχή (psukhḗ, “soul”) + Latin -logia (“study of”)). Equivalent to psycho- +‎ -logie.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˌpsi.xoː.loːˈɣi/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: psy‧cho‧lo‧gie
  • Rhymes: -i

Noun

[edit]

psychologie f (plural psychologieën, diminutive psychologietje n)

  1. psychology
    Synonym: zielkunde

Derived terms

[edit]
  • onderwijspsychologie
  • rechtspsychologie

Related terms

[edit]
  • psycholoog
  • psychologisch

Descendants

[edit]
  • Afrikaans: psigologie
  • → Indonesian: psikologi

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From New Latin psychologia (coined by Marko Marulić from Ancient Greek ψυχή (psukhḗ, “soul”) + Latin -logia (“study of”)).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /psi.kɔ.lɔ.ʒi/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -i

Noun

[edit]

psychologie f (uncountable)

  1. psychology

Derived terms

[edit]
  • psychologie inversée

Related terms

[edit]
  • psychiatrie
  • psychologique
  • psychologiquement
  • psychologiser
  • psychologue

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Dutch: psychologie
  • → Turkish: psikoloji

Further reading

[edit]
  • “psychologie”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012
